company.name: Zenzap
company.summary: Zenzap是一家为企业提供AI原生工作场所聊天与AI智能体平台的公司，旨在让员工与AI智能体在同一聊天空间中协作完成工作任务。
company.headquarters: 以色列特拉维夫、美国及欧洲

evidence_refs.quote: CEO and co-founder Guy Weiss previously founded and led bootstrapped company Stucco Media until its acquisition.
CTO Jonatan Bien has held senior technology positions at Voca.ai, which was acquired by Snap, and Viz.ai.
COO Noam Neumann previously held senior positions at Mobox and Matomy.
The startup has 50 staff in the U.S., Tel Aviv, and Europe.

Guy Weiss is building Zenzap, a private messenger with AI that wants to help companies communicate with their staff and arm them with their organization’s context while staying in line with IT and security rules.
Zenzap, a startup developing an enterprise communications platform and AI agents for work teams
has raised $33 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with additional investment from The Garage.

products.name: Zenzap
products.description: 面向企业的AI原生工作场所聊天与AI智能体平台，员工与AI智能体在同一聊天空间中协作，智能体可连接业务工具并执行任务。
products.target_customers: 非技术型企业，包括医疗、建筑、酒店、快餐、物流、金融等行业组织。
features: AI辅助语音笔记与通话转录

evidence_refs.quote: Zenzap offers usual chat features on its free tier, including group chats and direct messages, task management, calendar integration, and schedule management, as well as AI-powered voice chat and search.

The platform connects team chats on mobile devices and desktops with AI agents and workplace applications. According to the company, it offers thousands of integrations, known as connectors, alongside prebuilt agents and automations.

comparisons.name: Slack
comparisons.core_difference: Zenzap面向非技术组织，Slack几乎完全面向开发者社区。

evidence_refs.quote: The only work platform with any allegiance is Slack, and that’s almost entirely among the developer community. Zenzap is not focused on developers, but on the other 99% of employees using personal messaging apps and waiting for an agent of their own.

comparisons.name: WhatsApp
comparisons.core_difference: WhatsApp是面向私人通信的消费者产品，企业对其员工使用方式控制有限；Zenzap是面向企业的安全平台，提供集中管控。

evidence_refs.quote: WhatsApp is a consumer product designed primarily for private communication, he said, leaving businesses with limited control over how employees use it for work.

comparisons.name: Microsoft Teams
comparisons.core_difference: Zenzap面向移动优先的日常使用场景，Teams并非为此设计。

evidence_refs.quote: You can’t implement Slack and Microsoft Teams because they were not built for this day-to-day use case for mobile-first that is meant for average users

comparisons.name: ChatGPT
comparisons.core_difference: ChatGPT仅私下回答个人问题，Zenzap AI智能体在群聊中工作并直接执行业务工具中的操作。

evidence_refs.quote: Using a Zenzap AI agent is different from using ChatGPT or Claude directly because Zenzap AI agents take action and work with your whole team, while ChatGPT and Claude only answer questions privately to one person.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Zenzap能否将工作场所聊天转化为AI智能体可靠执行业务流程的界面，从而覆盖Slack未触及的非技术组织。已验证信号包括：公司已服务数千家组织，客户创建超过40,000个自动化工作流，平台提供超过400个连接器，并拥有FedEx、Dollar General、Taco Bell、Starbucks等具名客户。当前融资依赖的已验证信号是产品已从隐身模式进入市场并获得企业采用，但来源未披露估值、收入或独立的任务可靠性基准，因此资本判断的证据边界在于：客户采用和工作流数量为公司自报数据，缺乏独立验证的ROI或端到端任务可靠性证据。
